positive_cases.name: user_temp_directory
positive_cases.scenario: Binary executed from the per-user temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Image prefix matches the per-user temporary directory selection.

positive_cases.name: machine_temp_directory
positive_cases.scenario: Binary executed from the machine-wide Windows temporary directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Image prefix matches the machine temporary directory selection.

positive_cases.name: public_directory
positive_cases.scenario: Binary executed from the public profile directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Image prefix matches the public directory selection.

negative_cases.name: managed_program_files
negative_cases.scenario: Application executed from a managed installation directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Image prefix is outside every user-writable selection.

negative_cases.name: allowed_patch_installer
negative_cases.scenario: Approved patch installer executed from the temporary directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Path matches the selection but the approved installer filter removes it.

negative_cases.name: system_directory_binary
negative_cases.scenario: System utility executed from the system directory.
negative_cases.rationale: Image prefix is the system directory, which is not user writable.

negative_cases.name: temp_named_subdirectory_elsewhere
negative_cases.scenario: Binary executed from a managed directory that merely contains the word Temp.
negative_cases.rationale: The selection uses startswith, so a similarly named managed path is excluded.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
